info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Sale By Commission Id-spec
info.description: The Sales Retrieval by Commission ID API allows users to access detailed information regarding sales transactions based on a specific commission ID. This endpoint is particularly useful for finance teams and sales analysts who need to reconcile sales records with commission payments. By retrieving sales data tied to a commission, users can ensure accurate reporting and analysis. Typical use cases include generating commission reports and auditing sales performance.

get.summary: Retrieve commission details for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed commission information for a specific resource identified by its ID. Use this to get insights into commission structures and related data for sales personnel.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving commission details for a specific RES-100045 commission. This request body should contain the necessary parameters for the operation to process successfully.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, returning the requested commission data.

GetSaleByCommissionIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the Sales Commissions Operations GET request. It is expected to be a string value.

GetSaleByCommissionIdResponse_200.title: Sales Commissions Response

salesChannel.description: Channel through which the sale was made.

relationshipManagerId.description: Identifier for the relationship manager handling the prospect.

expectedValue.description: Represents the expected financial value from the transaction.

salesPersonId.description: Identifier for the salesperson involved in the transaction.

commissionPlanId.description: Identifier for the commission plan applicable to the sale.

eligibleRevenue.description: Total revenue that is eligible for commission.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the record (e.g., Active, Inactive).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the record.

GetSaleByCommissionIdResponse_200.description: Response object for the Sales Commissions API endpoint, containing details about the prospect, sales channel, expected values, and metadata.

ExpectedValue.title: Expected Value

amount.description: The expected amount of money in the transaction.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denominated.

ExpectedValue.description: Represents the financial expectations for a transaction which includes amount and currency.
